$comment: zh -> en map for @limuyang2/dsh-agent-team. Applied by build.mjs to a pinned
upstream release; the result is installed as a local plugin package.
Deliberately NOT translated (they are model-facing prompt text, out of scope):
- the draft-validated instruction beginning 草稿
Strings absent from this map are left exactly as upstream shipped them.
Leading/trailing spaces are significant: several entries are fragments that
the bundle concatenates with a number or a name at runtime.

strings.还没有可添加的助手模板: No assistant templates available to add
strings.从左侧助手列表添加成员。: Add members from the assistant list on the left.
strings.该交互请求已结束或不存在: That interaction has ended or does not exist
strings.允许用户和普通成员直接通信: Allow users to chat directly with regular members
strings.当前助手未加载 Skill: This assistant has no Skill loaded
strings.该交互请求不属于指定的会话: That interaction does not belong to the given conversation
strings.该交互请求已由其他页面处理: That interaction was already handled in another tab
strings.该成员将停止参与当前团队。: This member will stop taking part in the team.
strings.当前助手未加载 Skills: This assistant has no Skills loaded
strings.本轮输出已达到模型长度上限。: This turn hit the model's output length limit.
strings.交互响应类型与待处理请求不匹配: Response type does not match the pending interaction
strings.该交互请求不属于指定的团队成员: That interaction does not belong to the given team member
strings.选择助手可使用的 Skills: Choose the Skills this assistant may use
strings.仍可在“文件”中浏览工作区内容。: You can still browse the workspace under “Files”.
strings.所有成员将换用全新的对话上下文。: Every member will switch to a fresh conversation context.
strings.二进制文件无法显示文本 Diff。: Binary files have no text diff to show.
strings.变更过多，仅显示前 2000 项。: Too many changes; showing the first 2000.
strings.打开团队工作台，有团队正在执行任务: Open Team workbench — a team is running a task
strings.请先停止当前小助手回复，再切换会话: Stop the builder's current reply before switching conversation
strings.当前成员没有匹配的已加载 Skill: This member has no matching loaded Skill
strings.至少选择一个助手当团队 Leader。: Choose at least one assistant to be the team Leader.
strings.选择助手可使用的 MCP Server: Choose the MCP Servers this assistant may use
strings.创建和维护可在不同团队间复用的助手模板。: Create and maintain assistant templates reusable across teams.
strings.助手是可复用模板，解散团队不会删除助手。: Assistants are reusable templates; dissolving a team does not delete them.
strings.没有等待确认的助手草稿，请先重新校验草稿: No assistant draft is awaiting confirmation; validate the draft again
strings.当前 Workspace 不是 Git 仓库: This Workspace is not a Git repository
strings.必须等待用户在新的消息中明确同意当前助手配置: Wait for the user to explicitly approve this assistant configuration in a new message
strings.不会复制任务、对话上下文、消息历史或运行状态。: Tasks, conversation context, message history and run state are not copied.
strings.向 Leader 描述目标，由它组织团队协作。: Describe the goal to the Leader and let it organise the team.
strings.由当前 Provider 和模型决定可用档位。: The current provider and model determine the available levels.
strings.管理可在不同团队间复用的助手、模型和权限配置。: Manage assistants, models and permissions reusable across teams.
strings.管理成员、Leader、上下文和团队生命周期。: Manage members, the Leader, context and team lifecycle.
strings.这个文件只有元数据变化，没有可显示的文本差异。: This file has only metadata changes and no text diff to show.
strings.该交互请求不属于当前团队 Agent 小助手会话: That interaction does not belong to the current Team Agent Assistant conversation
strings.Enter 发送 · Shift+Enter 换行: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
strings.多个平级 Agent，共享一个 Workspace: Several peer agents sharing one Workspace
strings.正在读取该 Preset 的 MCP Server…: Reading MCP Servers for this preset…
strings.请先停止团队 Agent 小助手当前回复，再切换模型: Stop the Team Agent Assistant's current reply before switching model
strings.请先停止团队 Agent 小助手当前回复，再归档会话: Stop the Team Agent Assistant's current reply before archiving
strings.团队 Agent 小助手启动失败：${message}: Team Agent Assistant failed to start: ${message}
strings.等待 Leader 分配任务，或直接向该成员发送消息。: Waiting for the Leader to assign a task, or message this member directly.
strings.该 Agent Preset 没有可用的 Skill。: This agent preset has no Skills available.
strings.复用当前团队配置，并为每位成员创建全新 Session。: Reuse this team's configuration and give every member a fresh session.
strings.复用当前成员和配置，为所有成员创建全新 Session。: Reuse the current members and configuration, with a fresh session for each.
strings.通过对话设计助手，完整配置会在你确认后保存到助手模板库。: Design an assistant by chatting; the full configuration is saved to your template library after you confirm.
strings.例如：我需要一个负责 React 前端开发和代码审查的助手: For example: I need an assistant for React front-end work and code review
strings.更新助手模板只影响之后启动的团队成员，不修改已有成员快照。: Updating a template affects only members started later; existing member snapshots are unchanged.
strings.选择团队成员并指定一个 Leader。同一助手可多次选择。: Pick the team members and exactly one Leader. The same assistant may be added more than once.
strings.配置可复用的模型、权限与长期规则。具体任务在团队启动后发送。: Configure the reusable model, permissions and long-term rules. Send actual tasks after the team starts.
strings.归档后，该会话将不再显示在团队 Agent 小助手的历史记录中。: Once archived, this conversation no longer appears in the Team Agent Assistant history.
strings.随助手模板保存，在成员启动时加入系统提示词；这里不填写具体任务。: Saved with the template and added to the system prompt when a member starts. Do not put specific tasks here.
strings.创建助手后，就可以把它作为 Leader 或普通成员加入不同团队。: Once created, an assistant can join any team as Leader or as a regular member.
strings.选择 Leader 和成员，共享同一个 Workspace 协作。: Choose a Leader and members that collaborate in one shared Workspace.
strings.先通过右上角“管理助手”创建助手，再选择 Leader 和团队成员。: Create assistants under “Manage assistants” first, then choose a Leader and members.
strings.让多个 AI 助手组队协作。一个团队必须有且只有一个 Leader。: Let several AI assistants work as a team. A team must have exactly one Leader.
strings.问题“${question.id}”的自定义答案不能与单选项同时提交: Question “${question.id}” cannot take a custom answer together with a single-choice option
strings.思考模式：${reasoningModeLabel}；切换后下一轮生效: Thinking mode: ${reasoningModeLabel}; takes effect next turn
strings.查看当前助手加载的 ${skills.length} 个 Skills: View the ${skills.length} Skills this assistant has loaded
strings.描述你需要的角色，它会询问必要参数、整理长期提示词，并在确认后创建助手。: Describe the role you need; it asks for the missing settings, drafts the long-term instructions, and creates the assistant after you confirm.
strings.会话内容不会被删除，底层 Session 日志仍由 Harness 保留。: The conversation is not deleted; Harness still keeps the underlying session log.
strings.选择一个助手加入团队“${team.name}”。同一个助手可以多次加入。: Choose an assistant to join team “${team.name}”. The same assistant may join more than once.
strings.删除后不会影响团队或 Workspace。若模板仍被团队成员引用，系统会拒绝删除: Deleting does not affect teams or the Workspace. If a team member still references the template, deletion is refused.
strings.已使用约 ${usage.usedTokens} tokens，上下文窗口大小未: About ${usage.usedTokens} tokens used; context window size unknown
strings.当前 Harness 未为该 Agent Preset 配置 MCP Serve: Harness has no MCP Server configured for this agent preset.
strings.所有成员将停止，团队任务、消息和配置会被永久删除。助手模板与 Workspace: All members stop, and the team's tasks, messages and configuration are permanently deleted. Assistant templates and Workspace files are kept.
strings.只选择这个助手执行任务时可能需要的 Skills；运行时会按任务需要加载具体 S: Select only the Skills this assistant may need; the specific Skill instructions load per task at runtime.
strings.该成员将停止参与团队；若仍有未完成任务，系统会阻止移出。助手模板和 Sessio: This member stops taking part in the team. Removal is blocked while it still has unfinished tasks. The assistant template and session history are kept.
strings.例如：你负责前端实现；遵循现有代码风格；修改前先阅读相关文件；完成后向 Lead: For example: you own front-end implementation; follow the existing code style; read the relevant files before editing; report test results to the Leader when done.
strings.停止所有成员并清空任务板，为每位成员换用全新 Session。Workspace: Stop every member, clear the task board and give each member a fresh session. Workspace files and team configuration are unchanged.
strings.永久删除团队、任务和团队消息；助手模板与 Workspace 文件保留，旧 Se: Permanently delete the team, its tasks and its messages. Assistant templates and Workspace files are kept; old session logs are not restored.
strings.你好，我是团队 Agent 小助手。告诉我你想创建什么样的助手，以及它主要负责什: Hello — I'm the Team Agent Assistant. Tell me what kind of assistant you want and what it is mainly responsible for, and I'll ask about anything still missing.
strings.${member.displayName} 思考模式；当前为 ${reasoni: ${member.displayName} thinking mode; currently ${reasoningModeLabel}; takes effect next turn
strings.MCP 连接和密钥由 Harness Profile/Preset 统一管理；运: MCP connections and secrets are managed by the Harness profile/preset. At runtime only the selected servers' tools are exposed to the assistant.
strings.所有成员会停止，任务板和待处理消息会被清空，并换用全新 Session。Work: All members stop, the task board and queued messages are cleared, and every member gets a fresh session. Workspace files, team configuration and old session logs are kept.
strings.团队成员「${member.displayName}」（成员 ID：${memb: Team member “${member.displayName}” (member ID: ${member.id}) has been removed from the team; its session was stopped and archived. Reassign any further tasks to another member.
